facts.business: Shree Rama Multi-Tech Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of packaging materials comprising Multilayer Laminated Tubes, Tube Laminates and Flexible Laminates, catering primarily to oral care, pharmaceutical, cosmetic and FMCG sectors.
